name: BRHT — Fable Fury inventory source check — IMPORT READY

parameters.query:
SELECT
  lower(coalesce(source, 'unknown')) AS source,
  COUNT(*)::int AS snapshot_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT product_id)::int AS products,
  MAX(captured_at) AS latest_snapshot
FROM inventory_snapshots
GROUP BY lower(coalesce(source, 'unknown'))
ORDER BY source;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (lower(coalesce(i.source, 'unknown')), i.product_id)
    lower(coalesce(i.source, 'unknown')) AS source,
    i.product_id::text AS product_id,
    i.available::numeric AS available,
    i.captured_at,
    i.variant_id::text AS variant_id,
    i.inventory_item_id::text AS inventory_item_id,
    i.location_id::text AS location_id
  FROM inventory_snapshots i
  ORDER BY lower(coalesce(i.source, 'unknown')), i.product_id, i.captured_at DESC
)
SELECT
  l.source,
  l.product_id,
  COALESCE(p.product_name, pl.product_name, sp.product_name, l.product_id) AS product_name,
  l.available,
  l.captured_at,
  l.variant_id,
  l.inventory_item_id,
  l.location_id
FROM latest l
LEFT JOIN products p
  ON p.product_id::text = l.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_lookup pl
  ON pl.product_id::text = l.product_id
LEFT JOIN shopify_products sp
  ON sp.product_id::text = l.product_id
ORDER BY l.source, product_name
LIMIT 100;
